1: // Simple side‑scrolling "Canvas Escape" game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = canvas.width;
8:   const H = canvas.height;
9: 
10:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 20;
11:   const GROUND_HEIGHT = 30;
12:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
13:   const JUMP_SPEED = -12;
14:   const OBSTACLE_WIDTH = 20;
15:   const GAP_WIDTH = 60;
16: 
17:   let speed = 2; // base scroll speed (px per frame)
18:   let frame = 0;
19:   let running = true;
20: 
21:   const player = {
22:     x: 50,
23:     y: H - GROUND_HEIGHT - PLAYER_SIZE,
24:     vy: 0,
25:     width: PLAYER_SIZE,
26:     height: PLAYER_SIZE,
27:   };
28: 
29:   const obstacles = [];
30: 
31:   function spawnObstacle() {
32:     // random spike or gap
33:     if (Math.random() < 0.5) {
34:       // spike: rectangle from ground up
35:       const height = 15 + Math.random() * 25;
36:       obstacles.push({
37:         type: 'spike',
38:         x: W,
39:         y: H - GROUND_HEIGHT - height,
40:         width: OBSTACLE_WIDTH,
41:         height,
42:       });
43:     } else {
44:       // gap: just a missing ground segment
45:       obstacles.push({
46:         type: 'gap',
47:         x: W,
48:         width: GAP_WIDTH,
49:       });
50:     }
51:   }
52: 
53:   function update() {
54:     if (!running) return;
55: 
56:     // player physics
57:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
58:     player.y += player.vy;
59:     // ground collision
60:     const groundY = H - GROUND_HEIGHT - PLAYER_SIZE;
61:     if (player.y > groundY) {
62:       player.y = groundY;
63:       player.vy = 0;
64:     }
65: 
66:     // obstacles movement
67:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
68:       const o = obstacles[i];
69:       o.x -= speed;
70:       if (o.x + (o.width || 0) < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
71:     }
72: 
73:     // spawn logic
74:     if (frame % Math.max(80 - speed * 10, 30) === 0) spawnObstacle();
75: 
76:     // collision detection
77:     for (const o of obstacles) {
78:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
79:         const hitX = player.x + player.width > o.x && player.x < o.x + o.width;
80:         const hitY = player.y + player.height > o.y;
81:         if (hitX && hitY) {
82:           running = false;
83:         }
84:       } else if (o.type === 'gap') {
85:         // if player is over the gap and on ground, they fall
86:         const overGap = player.x + player.width > o.x && player.x < o.x + o.width;
87:         const onGround = player.y + player.height >= H - GROUND_HEIGHT;
88:         if (overGap && onGround) {
89:           player.vy = JUMP_SPEED; // fall through gap
90:         }
91:       }
92:     }
93: 
94:     // speed ramp
95:     speed += 0.0005;
96:     frame++;
97:   }
98: 
99:   function draw() {
100:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
101: 
102:     // ground
103:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
104:     ctx.fillRect(0, H - GROUND_HEIGHT, W, GROUND_HEIGHT);
105: 
106:     // obstacles
107:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
108:     for (const o of obstacles) {
109:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
110:         ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.width, o.height);
111:       }
112:     }
113: 
114:     // player
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00ff00';
116:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.width, player.height);
117: 
118:     // simple game‑over overlay
119:     if (!running) {
120:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
121:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
122:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
123:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
124:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
125:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
126:     }
127:   }
128: 
129:   function loop() {
130:     update();
131:     draw();
132:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
133:   }
134: 
135:   // input – click or tap anywhere
136:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
137:     if (!running) {
138:       // restart
139:       obstacles.length = 0;
140:       player.y = H - GROUND_HEIGHT - PLAYER_SIZE;
141:       player.vy = 0;
142:       speed = 2;
143:       frame = 0;
144:       running = true;
145:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
146:     } else if (player.vy === 0) {
147:       player.vy = JUMP_SPEED;
148:     }
149:   });
150: 
151:   // start game
152:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
153: })();
